description: The adaptive object type of all adaptive model object type objects. Each model object type may map to a mappedObjectType on mappedAdapterId and/or override adapter operations with on* Adaptive Scripts. When the model adapter has no mappedAdapterId, every operation that will be used must be implemented in the corresponding on* hook (pure-script object type).

custom.brief: Custom variables accessed throughout this Object Type
custom.description: Object type level qualifier custom:: variables available to model expressions.
custom.label: Custom

mappedObjectType.brief: The objectTypeId to map this to and from
mappedObjectType.description: This is the objectType used on the mapped adapter for default processing. If not specified, current::objectType (this model object type id) is used. Default map-and-forward requires mappedAdapterId on the model adapter conf.
mappedObjectType.label: Mapped Object Type

onAddObject.description: Override default add_object() processing. Return the new objectId as a string. Return current::useDefaultProcessing to map-and-forward to mappedAdapterId (requires mappedAdapterId). If the model adapter has no mappedAdapterId, this hook must fully handle add for this object type when add is used. During evaluation, current:: (and custom:: / adapter:: when pushed) are available as qualified variables; contextType modelAddObject documents that bag. For debug/tools, qualifier("current") returns a snapshot object of the current bag (not for hot paths).
onAddObject.label: On add_object

onDeleteObject.description: Override default delete_object() processing. Return current::useDefaultProcessing to map-and-forward to mappedAdapterId (requires mappedAdapterId). If the model adapter has no mappedAdapterId, this hook must fully handle delete for this object type when delete is used. During evaluation, current:: (and custom:: / adapter:: when pushed) are available; contextType modelDeleteObject documents that bag. qualifier("current") can snapshot it for debug/tools.
onDeleteObject.label: On delete_object
onDeleteObject.skeleton:
/**
 * onDeleteObject
 *
 * Override default delete_object() processing, or return
 * current::useDefaultProcessing (requires mappedAdapterId).
 */
return current::useDefaultProcessing;

onGetInitialObjectId.brief: Optional script value is evaluated to determine the objectId on add requests
onGetInitialObjectId.description: This optional script value is evaluated during default add processing to determine the objectId. If not specified, current::objectId is used and if that is not specified, the mapped adapter may assign one. Even if specified, the mapped adapter is free to ignore this. Only used when default add processing runs (requires mappedAdapterId unless onAddObject fully handles add). Uses contextType modelInitialObjectId for current:: variables; qualifier("current") can snapshot that bag for debug/tools.
onGetInitialObjectId.label: On Get Initial ObjectId

onGetObject.description: Override default get_object() processing. Return an object, or nullish if not found. Return current::useDefaultProcessing to map-and-forward to mappedAdapterId (requires mappedAdapterId). If the model adapter has no mappedAdapterId, this hook must fully handle get for this object type when get is used. During evaluation, current:: (and custom:: / adapter:: when pushed) are available as qualified variables; contextType modelGetObject documents that bag. For debug/tools, qualifier("current") returns a snapshot of the current bag (not for hot paths).
onGetObject.label: On get_object
onGetObject.skeleton:
/**
 * onGetObject
 *
 * Return an object, nullish if not found, or current::useDefaultProcessing
 * (requires mappedAdapterId on the model adapter conf).
 *
 * Notable current:: variables: adapterId, objectType, objectId,
 * mappedAdapterId (if configured), mapBackObject, useDefaultProcessing.
 * Debug: qualifier("current") snapshots the bag.
 */
return current::useDefaultProcessing;

onModifyObject.description: Override default modify_object() processing. Return current::useDefaultProcessing to map-and-forward to mappedAdapterId (requires mappedAdapterId). If the model adapter has no mappedAdapterId, this hook must fully handle modify for this object type when modify is used. During evaluation, current:: is available; contextType modelModifyObject documents that bag. qualifier("current") can snapshot it for debug/tools.
onModifyObject.label: On modify_object
onModifyObject.skeleton:
/**
 * onModifyObject
 *
 * Override default modify_object() processing, or return
 * current::useDefaultProcessing (requires mappedAdapterId).
 */
return current::useDefaultProcessing;

onReplaceObject.description: Override default replace_object() processing. Return current::useDefaultProcessing to map-and-forward to mappedAdapterId (requires mappedAdapterId). If the model adapter has no mappedAdapterId, this hook must fully handle replace for this object type when replace is used. During evaluation, current:: is available; contextType modelReplaceObject documents that bag. qualifier("current") can snapshot it for debug/tools.
onReplaceObject.label: On replace_object
onReplaceObject.skeleton:
/**
 * onReplaceObject
 *
 * Override default replace_object() processing, or return
 * current::useDefaultProcessing (requires mappedAdapterId).
 */
return current::useDefaultProcessing;

onRetrieveObjects.description: Override default retrieve_objects() processing. Call current::returnObject(object) for each object to return (optional mapBack flag). Return current::useDefaultProcessing to map-and-forward to mappedAdapterId (requires mappedAdapterId). If the model adapter has no mappedAdapterId, this hook must fully handle retrieve for this object type when retrieve is used. During evaluation, current:: is available; contextType modelRetrieveObjects documents that bag (queryCriteria, returnObject, mapBackObject, …). qualifier("current") can snapshot it for debug/tools.
onRetrieveObjects.label: On retrieve_objects
onRetrieveObjects.skeleton:
/**
 * onRetrieveObjects
 *
 * Call current::returnObject(object) for each result, or return
 * current::useDefaultProcessing (requires mappedAdapterId).
 *
 * Notable current:: variables: queryCriteria, returnObject, mapBackObject,
 * objectType, mappedAdapterId (if configured), useDefaultProcessing.
 */
return current::useDefaultProcessing;

propertyTypes.brief: Property types for this model object type
propertyTypes.description: The name of the properties in this object corresponds to the property name of an instance of this object type and is its property type object.
propertyTypes.label: Property Types
